Thanks — quick technical clarifications and a proposed scope draft below.

Quoted for context:
> On Sun, 14 Mar 2027 at 09:12 Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@novumfinance.com> wrote:
> > Systems we expect to include in the initial pilot: customer portal (public web UI), payments backend services, and the internal admin dashboard. Confirm if those map to "in scope" for Redwood.

Our read of the systems inventory (based on your attachments):
- In scope: public customer portal (frontend + API), payments backend microservices (payment-processor, transaction-api), admin dashboard read-only UIs that call the same APIs.
- Out of scope: legacy analytics cluster, reporting ETL jobs, internal BI tools.

Data handling summary for procurement/legal:
- Embeddings: transient by default. Persistent embedding storage is opt-in and will be clearly documented in the SOW if Novum chooses it.
- Logs & event retention: standard pilot retention is 90 days for request logs and 30 days for debug traces; retention and exports can be adjusted under the SOW.
- Encryption: TLS in transit + customer-managed KMS recommended for Private/Dedicated deployments.

Operational asks for kickoff agenda (30–45m):
- Novum to confirm final systems inventory and point-of-contact for each system.
- Redwood to present pilot architecture (network requirements, peering options, auth flow).
- Procurement/legal to list required clauses (SLA, data residency, indemnity).

Next steps for us: Rishi, can you review the network PDF and flag any ports/VPC peering requirements and whether we should propose Dedicated vs Private for the pilot? Marissa, I will draft the SOW and a one-page commercial summary for Daniel.

Ava

Quick technical notes after reviewing novum_network_zones.pdf:

- Network / connectivity: We recommend VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink for the payments backend to avoid public egress for transaction traffic. Required outbound: 443 (TLS) and 5222 (internal control channel) — we'll provide an exact ACL list prior to kickoff.
- Deployment mode recommendation: Start with Dedicated (reserved capacity) in US region for predictable latency and easier auditability; move to Private if Novum requires customer-managed VPC/KMS.
- KMS & keys: For pilot, use Redwood-managed KMS with customer-supplied CMK on request. If Novum insists on HSM-only keys we will need 2–3 weeks more for integration and controls review.
- Models & cost sensitivity: For the initial integration we suggest a 7B quantized model variant for embeddings and a 13B variant for generation; I can provide token-rate estimates and a delta vs smaller quantized models by EOD tomorrow so Daniel has a one-pager.

I'll prepare the ACL list and a short pilot configuration (ports, peering options, recommended model variants) and share in a follow-up.

—Rishi
